This post shows how to compute a symbolic, deterministic semantic diff with an open-source anti-unification engine, so reviewers see only the genuine disagreements between two candidate authorization policies.

stories.title: Detecting and recovering from silent data corruption on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod
stories.summary: Silent data corruption is a GPU fault that returns wrong but plausible numbers with no error, quietly poisoning distributed training. This post adds three checks to a PyTorch DDP loop to detect it, localize the faulty node on Amazon SageMaker HyperPod, and hand the node to automatic recovery for replacement.
